title: AWS Polly ab Hindi bolta hai
content:
Ye awaaz kisi insaan ki nahi hai. Ye AWS ka AI hai... aur ab ye HINDI bolta hai.
Here is how you can use it in your next project.
Amazon Polly ek text-to-speech service hai.
Aap text do, ye awaaz bana deta hai.
Kal AWS ne iske Generative engine ka naya model launch kiya.
They say it sounds more natural and handles numbers, emails and addresses more reliably.
Numbers dekho.
Fourteen naye voices, nine locales mein.
Aur do nayi languages... Hindi aur Finnish.
Indian users ke liye do voices hain... Kiara aur Arjun, Hindi aur Indian English ke liye.
Ab ye India ke liye kyun bada hai?
Kyunki yahan har customer English mein baat nahi karna chahta.
Ek dukaan, ek clinic, ek coaching centre... inke customers apni bhasha mein sunna pasand karte hain.
Pehle achhi Hindi AI voice ke liye alag tools dhoondhne padte the.
Now it sits inside a service that many companies already use on AWS.
Teen practical ideas.
Idea ONE... appointment reminder calls, Hindi mein.
Idea TWO... e-learning videos ka Hindi voiceover, bina recording studio ke.
Idea THREE... ek voice bot jo customer ke common sawaalon ka jawab Hindi mein de.
Maan lo ek coaching centre har student ko fees reminder bhejta hai... wahi message ab Hindi awaaz mein ja sakta hai.
AWS also mentions a low-latency streaming API for real-time voice apps.
Shuru kaise karein?
AWS console mein Polly kholo, Generative engine chuno, aur Kiara ya Arjun select karo.
Apna text paste karo aur sun lo.
SSML tags still work, so you can control pauses and emphasis.
Mera take simple hai... pehle apne real sentences se test karo.
Hinglish, naam, phone numbers, address... sab sun ke check karo.
If it sounds wrong to your customer, it does not matter how good the demo was.
Aur pricing page zaroor dekho, before you send ten thousand calls.
Announcement ka link chahiye? Comment POLLY and I'll DM you the link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
